heading: Fifteenth replenishment

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The United States Governor of the Fund is authorized to contribute on behalf of the United States $513,900,000 to the fifteenth replenishment of the resources of the Fund, subject to obtaining the necessary appropriations.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: In order to pay for the United States contribution provided for in subsection (a), there are authorized to be appropriated, without fiscal year limitation, $513,900,000 for payment by the Secretary of the Treasury.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 94–302, title II, § 226, as added Pub. L. 116–136, div. B, title XI, § 21012(b)(4), Mar. 27, 2020, 134 Stat. 594.)
